def advisor(scope, time, cost, flex):
    if flex == 'scope':
        return time * cost
    if flex == 'time':
        return scope / cost
    if flex == 'cost':
        return scope / time
    raise ValueError('unknown flex')

print(advisor(10, 4, 2, 'scope'))
print(advisor(10, 4, 2, 'time'))
print(advisor(10, 4, 2, 'cost'))
